successCriteria.description: src/shared/error.types.ts exports NotFoundError, ValidationError, and ConflictError classes, each extending the native Error class with correct prototype-chain setup via Object.setPrototypeOf so instanceof checks work reliably.

src/shared/base.repository.ts exports a generic IBaseRepository<T> interface declaring five methods: findById(id: string): Promise<T | null>, findAll(): Promise<T[]>, create(entity: Omit<T, 'id'>): Promise<T>, update(id: string, entity: Partial<T>): Promise<T>, delete(id: string): Promise<void>.

src/shared/base.repository.ts exports an abstract BaseKnexRepository<T extends { id: string }> class that implements IBaseRepository<T>, accepts a Knex instance and a tableName string via its constructor, and provides concrete implementations of all five IBaseRepository<T> methods using the Knex query builder.
Jest unit tests exist in tests/unit/shared/error.types.test.ts covering instanceof checks, name, message, and cross-type discrimination for all three error classes.

Jest unit tests exist in tests/unit/shared/base.repository.test.ts covering findById (found and not-found), findAll, create, update, and delete methods of BaseKnexRepository using a mocked Knex instance.

constraints: GP-001: All database access must go through repository interfaces — BaseKnexRepository is the foundation for this pattern.
GP-006: Domain error classes (NotFoundError, ValidationError, ConflictError) must be used for surfacing repository errors across all modules.
Strict TypeScript: no implicit any, strict null checks — all method signatures must be fully typed.
BaseKnexRepository constructor must accept a Knex instance and a tableName string, matching the signature used by all module repositories that extend it.
Error classes must use Object.setPrototypeOf for correct prototype-chain setup so instanceof checks work reliably across the codebase.
outOfScope: Database connection factory (src/shared/db.connection.ts) — deferred to Phase 7.
Any module-specific repositories (KnexLeaveRepository, KnexLeaveBalanceRepository, etc.) — deferred to their respective phases.
Knex migrations, seeds, or knexfile.ts configuration — deferred to Phases 6 and 7.
Integration tests or end-to-end tests — only unit tests in tests/unit/shared/ are in scope for this phase.
